# Toonz and Tales

> Original sing-along songs and weekly story-song musicals for toddlers and preschoolers, with animal characters. Free to watch on YouTube. This site has no ads, sign-ups or tracking.

- YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@ToonzAndTales
- Website: https://toonzandtales.github.io/

## Musicals
- Wobble Town Rescue Crew: In every episode the crew helps someone in Wobble Town, and a mystery knot keeps turning up. Who is tying them? Watch in order! All 10 episodes are out now. Released so far: 10 of 10.
- Coral Cove Crew: A little reef band sings its way through ocean adventures, and someone keeps leaving shiny musical shells. Who is it? Watch in order! All 10 episodes are out now. Released so far: 10 of 10.
